reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to announce a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials list instead of a vague cost chip. This change allows you to see exactly what resources are stored and what is required for your construction projects, with shortages clearly highlighted. No more guessing what materials you need! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
